sections.heading: Reset a forgotten password
sections.text: Open the password reset page, enter the account email, and use the code sent by email.

sections.heading: Unrecognized sign-in request
sections.text: Reject a sign-in request you did not make, change the password, and contact support to secure the account.

sections.heading: Cancel renewal
sections.text: Open Billing, choose the active plan, and select Cancel renewal before the next billing date.

sections.heading: Refund window
sections.text: A first subscription payment can be reviewed for a refund within 14 days. Renewal payments are not automatically refundable.

sections.heading: Order still processing
sections.text: Processing can take up to two business days. Check the order page for the current estimate.

sections.heading: Marked delivered but missing
sections.text: Check the delivery address and nearby safe locations, then contact support with the order number if the package is still missing.
